versions.text: There must be a means in the UCS to indicate to the UAV crew the active mode of control of the flight control system. If semi-automatic mode is engaged, a specific indicator must be activated in clear view of the UAV crew.

There must be a means in the UCS to indicate to the UAS crew the active mode of control of the flight control system. If semi-automatic mode is engaged, a specific indicator must be activated in clear view of the UAS crew.
